newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks fall more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks fall more than 50 points.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks fell more than 50 points in the last session of the year Tuesday as reports pointing to possible stronger-than-expected economic growth sparked fears of rising interest rates.

The Dow Jones industrial average lost 55.36 points to 6,494.01 in late afternoon trading. Stocks got hit by weakness in the bond market, where the benchmark 30-year Treasury lost more than 1-1/4 points, raising its yield to 6.64 percent from 6.54 percent on Monday.
